event_location.description: Five interactive light-bulb switch events; two ROM map-event arrays point to their scripts.
event_location.region_hint: Both map headers contain section byte 0x62, which indexes the ROM map-name table to Antisis Port. Exact room and access route are not yet human-verified.
event_location.how_to_reach: Use a progressed save with access to the bulb-switch puzzle in the Antisis Port section. If the screen is not there, trace the two map headers above; do not assume a NEW GAME route.

cases.how_to_trigger: Interact with a bulb while the script chooses its on branch; toggle state if needed.
cases.expected_text:
なにかの でんきゅうの ようだ。
オンに しますか？
what_to_visually_verify: でんきゅう, not きゅうこん
オン is kana, not Latin on
green color applies to オン only
following に しますか？ remains Japanese
line break and confirmation advance are normal

cases.how_to_trigger: Toggle the same bulb, then interact again to choose its off branch.
cases.expected_text:
なにかの でんきゅうの ようだ。
オフに しますか？
what_to_visually_verify: オフ is kana, not Latin off
green color applies to オフ only
following Japanese page and punctuation are intact

note: Expected wording is semantic. Actual line wrap follows controlfix; no emulator check has been performed.
